review_type: independent read-only integration review against HEAD

verification.method: Per-file git diff HEAD and source/caller inspection; findings are static code-path proofs, not executed reproductions.
verification.limitation: Concurrent worker tree is changing. Locations refer to source read during this review. Parent owns runtime regression tests and full gates.

logic_errors.title: Validator rejects actual Anthropic tool snapshots, dropping signed native state on persistence/replay
logic_errors.trigger: An Anthropic run returns thinking/signature plus a tool_use block, executes that tool, then emits its provider snapshot or later reloads the session.
evidence: provider.rs:54-56 assistant_message(Anthropic) returns content blocks only, intentionally without OpenAI tool_calls.
runner.rs:2091-2125 populates pending IDs only from message.tool_calls.
runner.rs:2135-2146 requires each native tool_use ID already be in pending; an actual provider-produced message therefore fails validation.
runner.rs:116-126 suppresses provider_state when validation fails, so all subsequent snapshots for the same tool-bearing run also fail.
runner.rs:2177-2185 rejects an otherwise correctly persisted native transcript too. The existing runner test adds tool_calls to its Anthropic fixture and misses the real helper contract.
logic_errors.impact: Normal tool-bearing Anthropic runs cannot persist/replay the signed thinking blocks the changes were intended to preserve. Follow-up uses lossy UI reconstruction instead; thinking-enabled continuation may be rejected or lose provider-native state.
logic_errors.smallest_fix: Validate native content tool_use blocks as the authoritative source of pending IDs, validating ID/name/object input and uniqueness there. Accept matching legacy tool_calls only as optional mirrors; do not require or inject duplicate tool_calls. Add a runner regression using StreamResult.assistant_message(Anthropic) unchanged, followed by its actual tool result and final assistant.

logic_errors.title: Provider-native history is replayed into a different adapter without origin binding or translation
logic_errors.trigger: Complete an Anthropic text/thinking response without tools, then change the session provider to OpenAI/Ollama and send another message. Alternatively switch a persisted DeepSeek transcript to another adapter.
evidence: types.rs:287-289 stores provider_messages without originating provider/adapter/model identity.
runner.rs:1072-1073 invokes append_history_message without the current provider.
runner.rs:2177-2185 unconditionally prefers any structurally valid native snapshot; native Anthropic text/thinking-only snapshots pass the current validator.

provider.rs:624-626 copies these messages unchanged into the OpenAI-compatible request body. Anthropic thinking/redacted_thinking/text block types are not converted to that adapter's assistant content format.
provider.rs:62-63 creates DeepSeek reasoning_content, but native replay can later send it to unrelated adapters despite the helper's initial kind check.
logic_errors.impact: A supported provider change can make subsequent requests fail with invalid content block types or carry provider-specific reasoning fields to an unintended endpoint. After fixing INATIVE-01, this also affects tool-bearing signed transcripts.
logic_errors.smallest_fix: Persist the native snapshot's originating adapter/provider identity, pass the active identity into history replay, and replay opaque native blocks only for a compatible origin. On adapter changes use an explicitly normalized text/tool transcript with incompatible thinking/signature/reasoning fields removed; never alter signatures and forward them as if native to another provider. Test Anthropic-to-OpenAI and DeepSeek-to-other transitions.

logic_errors.title: New workspace-filtered status hides changes that the existing commit action still stages and commits
logic_errors.trigger: Select a subdirectory of a Git repository as the workspace. Modify a file inside it and a sibling file outside it, then commit from the application's changes UI.
evidence: git.rs:159-167 changes status from repository-wide porcelain to status --porcelain=v1 -z -- . scoped to cwd.
git.rs:94-99 additionally filters returned paths by the workspace prefix.
git.rs:204-207 still runs git add -A without a pathspec, which stages changes across the repository, not just that subdirectory; git.rs:219-224 then commits the repository index.

The new status_preserves_rename_unicode_and_workspace_relative_names test explicitly creates outside.txt and expects it absent from the returned file list. Frontend useAgent.ts commitWorkspaceChanges and FilesChangedCard.tsx still invoke the same git_commit command.
logic_errors.impact: The changes/commit UI now omits out-of-workspace modifications that its commit operation includes. Users can unknowingly commit unrelated or sensitive sibling files; previously repository-wide status exposed them.
logic_errors.smallest_fix: Keep status/commit scope consistent. The smallest integration fix is to retain repository-wide status visibility with explicit repo-relative paths for the repository-wide commit action. If commits must be workspace-scoped instead, scope staging and explicitly handle or reject already-staged out-of-workspace entries before committing; merely adding a pathspec to git add is insufficient.

logic_errors.title: Transcript export duplicates flattened multi-segment text
logic_errors.trigger: An ordinary multi-tool response has post-first-tool text in two or more segments. For example segment texts are opening, intermediate, and final while message.content is intermediate concatenated with final.
evidence: Frontend useAgent.ts:285-305 records each chunk in the chronological segment and also appends it to aggregate message.content; the first tool moves only the initial content into preamble.
storage.rs:650-653 already emits every segment text.
storage.rs:668-673 decides aggregate content is missing if no single segment equals all of message.content. A multi-segment aggregate fails that equality test and is appended again.

render_markdown, render_standalone_html and deterministic_summary now consume this helper. The added export test uses aggregate content equal to its final segment, so it does not cover the real multi-segment aggregate shape.
logic_errors.impact: Markdown/HTML export repeats intermediate/final narrative, and deterministic compaction wastes its bounded summary budget repeating the same text.
logic_errors.smallest_fix: Compare aggregate content against the relevant concatenated segment narrative, not any one segment; append only a genuinely absent legacy tail. Add a fixture matching actual frontend aggregation with at least two post-tool text segments.

suggestions: Add integration tests joining provider helper -> runner snapshot validator -> persisted reload; isolated helper and hand-built validator fixtures currently assert incompatible contracts.
Keep full native/frontend gates with the parent; this review intentionally ran no builds/tests and edited no implementation files.
summary: Fail integration: concrete new regressions affect Anthropic signed-state persistence, cross-provider native replay, and hidden repository-wide commit scope; transcript export also duplicates multi-segment text.

accuracy.evidence: Every finding traces added production logic and real callers; runtime reproduction intentionally excluded by delegation.

completeness.evidence: All ten requested file diffs inspected in one bounded pass; not an exhaustive interleaving or OS process-tree proof.

clarity.evidence: Each finding includes exact source locations, concrete trigger and impact; cross-file evidence requires several references.

actionability.evidence: Smallest fixes and missing regression cases supplied; implementation and execution belong to parent.

conciseness.evidence: Four distinct new issues only; JSON contains supporting detail needed for parent triage.

self_evaluation.highest_value_follow_up: Parent should first test real Anthropic helper output against the runner validator, then adapter switching and subdirectory commit scope.
self_evaluation.self_check: The verdict distinguishes static proof from runtime verification and does not re-list unresolved original audit findings.
